RFC9069-4.2-1.note: Re-judged 2026-09-29. Positive: rfc9069_verdict_test.go::TestLocallySourcedRouteIsConveyedWithTheLocRIBPeerType (empty AS_PATH best change, Peer Type 3 on Peer Up and on the Route Monitoring carrying 10.20.30.0/24) and rfc9069_test.go::TestLocRIBFeedConveysRoutesWithTheLocRIBPeerType. Negative (R1(b), inputs pushed toward the violation): ::TestLocallySourcedRouteIsNotConveyedUnderTheMonitoredPeer gives the locally sourced route the monitored peer's address 10.0.0.1 as next hop and requires, on both Peer Up and Route Monitoring, Peer Type 3, a zero peer address and the router's own AS 65000 and BGP ID; a producer attributing the route to that peer fails it. The neighbour-rule negative TestMonitoredPeerRouteMonitoringIsNotTheLocRIBPeerType no longer carries this tag. Records observed red for all three units (locRIBPeerHeader break).

RFC9069-5.1-1.note: Forbidden: a timestamp that is not the install time (a wall clock on a replay), or zero where the install time is known. internal/component/bgp/plugins/bmp/rfc9069_test.go::TestLocRIBIncrementalRouteMonitoringCarriesTheInstallTime: got==0 Fatal and outside [before,after] Errorf; ::TestLocRIBReplayAndPeerUpCarryNoTimestamp: replay RM and Peer Up timestamps must be (0,0). Precision is implementation dependent, so microseconds are not owed.

RFC9069-5.2-1.note: Re-judged 2026-09-29 after the D-8 fix. Producer read: fabricateLocRIBOpen now adds one Extended Next Hop capability (1,1,2), because rib entryNextHopAddr answers an IPv4 unicast next hop from MP_REACH_NLRI when no legacy NEXT_HOP exists and buildLocRIBUpdateBody then writes MP_REACH AFI 1 with a 16-octet next hop. 'All necessary': rfc9069_verdict_test.go::TestLocRIBIPv4RouteWithIPv6NextHopIsBackedByExtendedNextHop encodes that route, reads AFI 1 and NH length 16 off the MP_REACH octets, and requires the ENH pair in the decoded OPEN. 'Only include': ::TestFabricatedLocRIBOpenCarriesOnlyCapabilitiesTheRouteMonitoringUses fails on any capability other than ASN4, Multiprotocol and ENH, and requires exactly one ASN4, Multiprotocol set == dumpFamilies, exactly one ENH naming only (1,1,2). {single-polarity: positive} holds: one list, no divergent input. bmp_locrib_test.go::TestFabricatedLocRIBOpenCarriesTheRequiredCapabilities carries no discrimination record; the two recorded units carry the whole requirement.

RFC9069-5.2.1-1.note: Forbidden: a Loc-RIB Peer Up without the type-3 TLV, a name other than 'global' for the zero-distinguisher default instance, a value outside 1..255 bytes, or a Peer Down missing the TLV. internal/component/bgp/plugins/bmp/rfc9069_test.go::TestLocRIBPeerUpAndPeerDownCarryTheGlobalTableName: Distinguisher 0, exactly one TLV, assertTableNameTLV (type, value, 1..255, length field) on Peer Up and on the Peer Down after reason 6. Negative ::TestMonitoredPeerUpCarriesNoTableNameTLV. 'If a name is configured' is conditional on a table-name leaf ze does not have.

RFC9069-5.3-1.note: Forbidden: a Loc-RIB Peer Down with a reason other than 6. internal/component/bgp/plugins/bmp/rfc8671_test.go::TestBMPReloadTurningLocRIBOffUnsubscribesAndSaysSo: down.Reason != PeerDownTLVData Errorf, on the Loc-RIB peer type, read off the socket. Single-polarity marker.

RFC9069-5.4.1-1.note: Forbidden: 2-byte ASN encoding in Loc-RIB Route Monitoring. internal/component/bgp/plugins/bmp/bmp_locrib_test.go::TestLocRIBRouteMonitoringUsesFourByteASNs: AS_PATH length must be 2+4n (Fatal) and ASN 4200000001 must round-trip (Errorf). Both polarity tags on one unit, each clause asserted.

RFC9069-6.1.1-1.note: Re-judged 2026-09-29. rfc9069_verdict_test.go::TestReceiverKeepsEachPeersAddressFamiliesApart sends two Peer Ups on ONE router, IPv4 unicast for BGP ID 10.0.0.1 and IPv6 unicast for 10.0.0.2, and reads back through the peers command that each peer holds exactly its own family, so a router-keyed or merged association goes red. With TestReceiverRecordsThePeerUpAddressFamilies (positive) and TestReceiverRecordsNoFamiliesWhenThePeerUpAdvertisesNone (no MP capability records no family, not a default), both polarities of processing the capabilities per peer hold.

RFC9069-6.1.1-2.note: First verdict 2026-09-29. rfc9069_verdict_test.go::TestLocRIBPeerUpOpenIndicatesTheAddressFamilies drives one best change, reads the Loc-RIB Peer Up off the collector end of the pipe (Peer Type 3), and requires both the sent and the received OPEN to carry Multiprotocol capabilities equal to dumpFamilies, the families the emulated peer's Route Monitoring and End-of-RIB carry. {single-polarity: positive} holds: ze has one emulated peer and every producer of its Peer Up passes the one fabricateLocRIBOpen result, so no input yields a Loc-RIB Peer Up to refuse.

RFC9069-6.1.3-1.note: Re-judged 2026-09-29. rfc9069_verdict_test.go::TestBehaviorChangeBouncesTheLocRIBEmulatedPeer applies a route-monitoring-policy change through applySenderConfig on a session with the Loc-RIB Peer Up sent, and requires the Peer Type 3 messages to be exactly [Peer Down, Peer Up]; TestBehaviorChangeBouncesThePeersOfALocRIBSession requires the monitored BGP peer's Peer Down then Peer Up; TestAConfigurationThatAltersNoBehaviorBouncesNothing requires no bounce on a reload that moves no behavior leaf. Row prose now names these units. Table names: ze has the one fixed name 'global', so no rename input exists.

RFC9069-x-1.note: Forbidden: a reserved (non-F) per-peer flag bit transmitted as 1 on the Loc-RIB header. internal/component/bgp/plugins/bmp/bmp_locrib_test.go::TestLocRIBPeerHeader: ph.Flags != 0 is Errorf, red on any set bit. Single-polarity marker: no producer sets a flag, so no negative input exists. The row claims only the transmit half; the 'ignored on receipt' clause of the same sentence is not quoted and has no row.

RFC9069-x-2.note: Forbidden: a Loc-RIB instance with no emulated peer, i.e. no Loc-RIB Peer Up. internal/component/bgp/plugins/bmp/bmp_locrib_test.go::TestLocRIBSinglePeerUpPerInstance: peerUps != 1 is Errorf, red on zero (and on one per BGP peer). Single-polarity marker. Ze runs one Loc-RIB instance, so the 'such as with VRFs' plurality has no second instance to exercise.

RFC9069-x-3.note: Forbidden: a received-OPEN field that is not a repeat of the sent OPEN. internal/component/bgp/plugins/bmp/bmp_locrib_test.go::TestHandleBestChangeEmitsPeerUpThenRM: len(up.SentOpenMsg)==0 is Fatal and !bytes.Equal(SentOpenMsg, ReceivedOpenMsg) is Errorf. Single-polarity marker. The fabricated-OPEN sentence is RFC9069-5.2-1's quote.

RFC9069-x-4.note: Re-judged 2026-09-29 (row prose rewritten, claim unchanged). rfc9069_verdict_test.go::TestStartLocRIBDeliversTheInitialDumpAsRouteMonitoring subscribes a stand-in RIB that answers startLocRIB's replay-request with one best change carrying its token, and requires after the Loc-RIB Peer Up a Route Monitoring of Peer Type 3 carrying 10.20.30.0/24: the initial synchronization arrives as Route Monitoring. bmp_locrib_test.go::TestStartLocRIBTriggersInitialDump asserts the trigger and its per-dump tokens; it carries no discrimination record, the delivery unit does (startLocRIB break). {single-polarity: positive} holds: no non-conformant input to refuse.

RFC9069-x-5.note: Forbidden: a non-zero Peer Address on the Loc-RIB header. internal/component/bgp/plugins/bmp/bmp_locrib_test.go::TestLocRIBPeerHeader: ph.Address != [16]byte{} is Errorf. Single-polarity marker.

RFC9069-x-6.note: Forbidden: Peer AS other than the router's primary ASN (zero, a constant, AS_TRANS). internal/component/bgp/plugins/bmp/bmp_locrib_test.go::TestLocRIBPeerHeader PeerAS != 4200000001 Errorf; ::TestLocRIBPeerHeaderCarriesTheIdentityItIsGiven two identities must give 65001 and 65002; internal/component/bgp/plugins/bmp/rfc8671_test.go::TestRFC9069ReloadTurningLocRIBOnAnnouncesTheRouterIdentity reads Peer AS 4200000001 off the wire with the OPEN cache empty.

RFC9069-x-7.note: Forbidden: Peer BGP ID other than the global instance router-id. internal/component/bgp/plugins/bmp/bmp_locrib_test.go::TestLocRIBPeerHeader PeerBGPID != 0x0a141e01 Errorf. Single-polarity marker. The VRF clause is conditional on a VRF Loc-RIB instance, which ze does not implement (one global instance), so it has no reachable case.
